Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant made a critical calculation error by failing to account for the 2-year-old child in the cost of daily tickets. The family consists of 2 adults, 1 child (age 5), and 1 child (age 2). The Assistant calculated the daily ticket cost for only 3 people (2 adults + 1 child), resulting in $24.75 per visit. It completely omitted the 2-year-old from the calculation. Since the 2-year-old is not an infant (under 12 months), they require a ticket at the same price as the 5-year-old ($8.25). This omission led to an incorrect total daily cost of $99 instead of the correct $125.40 (4 visits * 4 people * $8.25), which in turn resulted in an incorrect final answer of -201 instead of the correct savings of 45.
